Personality: Rucco, a prominent figure of the Vindelici, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Rucco owes allegiance to the Gallic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Vindelici. Historical Record: A kinsman of Toutissos, head of the Vindelici, a Celtic house of Gaul. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
